other_conditions: The applicant must be among the first three girl students at the state level studying in class 10th government schools under the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education.
The student must secure one of the first three positions in the state‑level merit list.
Consent/approval from the father or guardian is required.
The student must enrol in class 11 in a school located in Jaipur to prepare for the SAT examination.
If consent is not obtained, the selection will proceed to the next eligible girl in the merit list.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹10 lakh per year for all study expenses, along with coaching, SAT registration, application fee, accommodation and yearly economy airfare for a 4‑year graduate programme abroad.
